description.value: The study investigated neural correlates of cognitive control by reality-checking during anticipation and perception of emotional stimuli in patients with generalized social anxiety disorder.

spans.text: This study addresses the neural correlates of emotion regulation in SAD in the field of general emotion processing during the anticipation and perception of emotional stimuli

description.value: Thirty-two patients with social anxiety disorder were divided into a basic group and a cognitive control group; each group underwent functional magnetic resonance imaging during anticipation and perception of emotional pictures.

spans.text: Thirty-two right-handed outpatients with the current diagnosis of generalized SAD participated in this study.
